lines.speaker: doban
lines.text: Fire!
*Rat-tat-tat-tat*
Mass-produced Nikkes open fire on Dorothy.
Dorothy effortlessly evades the fusillade, lost in thought.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I suppose this must be because of the Queen...
'The Ark's leadership must already know that the Queen has come to the surface.'
'Information that is highly confidential.'
'They're attacking me on grounds that I disclosed that information and stirred up unrest among the public.'
'But this is not what I had in mind.'
'One would expect leadership would summon me for a meeting, or even an interrogation, for leaking classified intel.'
'I intended to make my case for the necessity of the Third Surface Reclamation War. But of course, leadership couldn't possibly be swayed.'
'But for the Nikkes who are completely kept in the dark, and the civilians who are equally uninformed?'
'The mounting chaos within the Ark would have been more than enough to shake them to the core. I need to be the one who puts those fears to rest.'
'It's impossible to explain everything to them as it were, so some degree of deception is necessary.'
'That way, it will be easier to incite them. After all, what people want are visible facts and solutions. What lies beneath never interests them.'
'The performance I've put on in the Ark until now should be sufficient to draw in both Nikkes and the people alike.'
*Rat-tat-tat-tat*
'But this I did not anticipate.'
'I didn't think they would attack without warning. And In the middle of the city, no less.'

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: What's going on?
Dorothy avoids every bullet as they rain down on her.
Citizens flee in terror or collapse to the ground.
She moves carefully so no one gets hurt.
Any casualties will prove fatal to her plan. Even the slightest association to what is going on would be just as fatal.

lines.speaker: doban
lines.text: You little rat...!

lines.speaker: doban
lines.text: Where are my damned reinforcements?!
The moment Doban's shout fades, a swarm of mass-produced Nikkes appear.
They open fire on Dorothy.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: This could go on forever.
Dorothy dashes forward.
Weaving the hail of bullets, she charges toward the mass-produced Nikkes spread into formation.
She does not draw her gun. Instead, using hand-to-hand combat, she takes them down one by one.
With no knowledge of close-quarters combat, the mass-produced Nikkes begin to fall.
Dorothy keeps dropping them without pause.

lines.speaker: doban
lines.text: Tch...! Damned Pilgrim!

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Deputy Chief Doban.

lines.speaker: doban
lines.text: Oh. So you know who I am.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Information on the Ark's commander in chief and deputy chiefs is kept well-hidden.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: With the exception of yours. So it left an impression.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Given the low security clearance, I assume you aren't anyone of significance. Am I right?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I don't believe we've formally been introduced.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Have we met before?

lines.speaker: doban
lines.text: Like hell we have.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Then do you hold some personal grudge against me?

lines.speaker: doban
lines.text: It's nothing personal.

lines.speaker: doban
lines.text: I'm acting on behalf of the Ark.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: ... What did you say?

lines.speaker: doban
lines.text: I've known about your little scheme all along.

lines.speaker: doban
lines.text: I won't let you have your revenge on the Ark.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Revenge on the Ark? What on earth are you...

lines.speaker: doban
lines.text: You're part of the Goddess Squad...

lines.speaker: doban
lines.text: ... And you're the acting leader, Dorothy.

lines.speaker: doban
lines.text: That's right. You must want revenge, don't you?

lines.speaker: doban
lines.text: The Ark should have been yours, and yet there's no place for any of you in it.

lines.speaker: doban
lines.text: But I won't allow it.

lines.speaker: doban
lines.text: As long as I, Deputy Chief Doban, am here,

lines.speaker: doban
lines.text: You won't have your revenge on the Ark.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: You...

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: How do you know any of this?
Seeing Dorothy's reaction, Doban becomes certain.
This is it.
This is real.
With this, he can make a name for himself.
Doban was born in the Outer Rim.
He was raised by a father who dealt with the stress of a difficult life by beating him mercilessly.
To this day, he's unsure if that man was truly his father. Perhaps that was simply what he wanted to believe.
One day, while living hand to mouth as a collector, a Central Government soldier showed up in Ephialtes.
Everyone groveled before the soldier and obtained food and money in return.
Doban polished the soldier's shoes out of curiosity, and the soldier gave him money.
It was a large sum that would take three months of work to earn, but he turned down the money.
Instead, he smiled and claimed he was only doing this because he enjoyed it.
The soldier took an interest in this young boy from the Outer Rim. One who expected no compensation.
The soldier stayed in Ephialtes for a month, putting Doban to work as his errand boy.
Doban served the soldier wholeheartedly, and on the last day, the soldier said to him:
"Come to the Ark and serve me there."
And so, Doban received an identification chip from the soldier and headed for the Ark.
One month was all it took.
The identification chip that everyone in the Outer Rim could only dream of had come to him, simply because he served an unnamed soldier for a month.
It didn't take long for him to realize that everything he so desperately desired in the Outer Rim is easily obtained in the Ark.
Doban lived as a citizen of the Ark before becoming a soldier.
One day, an opportunity arose for him to tour the Outer Rim, which he accepted without hesitation.
He did so because he found himself missing his hometown.
The moment he crossed the partition, however, Doban was horrified.
Had this place always been this filthy and dark?
Someone approached him and polished his shoes.
It was the man he used to call father.
The man repeatedly bowed and polished Doban's shoes, but had no idea who Doban was.
Doban ground the man underfoot, then fled the Outer Rim.
He was ashamed. Ashamed that he comes from such a putrid cesspool.
He despised himself for ever considering that place home, and for missing it even briefly.
From that day on, Doban became vitriolic in his disdain for the Outer Rim.
He believed that if the Outer Rim disappeared, his shameful and disgusting past would disappear along with it.
He proposed a policy targeting the Outer Rim to the Central Government.
The policy called for isolating the Outer Rim and designating it as a dumping ground.
The Central Government approved the proposal and gave Doban full oversight.
From the Central Government's perspective, the Outer Rim had always been a headache. But abandoned or not, it was still a place where people lived.
But the policy Doban presented treated the Outer Rim as a place bereft of inhabitants.
If things went wrong, all blame could be pinned on Doban. From the Central Government's perspective, there was no reason to refuse.
The Outer Rim began to turn into hell.
Doban soon gained recognition for his role in resolving such a troublesome matter, and rose to a high-ranking position.
From then on, Doban directed all troublesome and unsavory matters into the Outer Rim.
The place descended further into hell.
Meanwhile, the quality of life in the Ark continued to rise.
As a result of this repeated cycle,
Doban rose to the position of Deputy Chief.
He felt on top of the world. That someone like him from the Outer Rim could rise all the way to Deputy Chief. It felt like a dream.
But that was where it ended.
With the Ark stabilized, there was nothing left to dump in the Outer Rim.
Whenever problems arose in the Ark, he engineered it to appear as the Outer Rim's handiwork, only to be repeatedly foiled by the Underworld Queen and Exotic.
He hears whispers behind his back. He's accused of selling out his own hometown for a promotion, and now that he's without a scapegoat, he's powerless.
Doban began to grow anxious.
He had a dream to make the Ark his own personal fiefdom.
The thought of an Outer Rim native standing atop the Ark filled him with unbridled joy.
But he had no way of getting there. Save for his capacity for inhumane methods, Doban had no real talent.
His standing naturally began to erode, and nobody acknowledged his worth.
He was excluded from important meetings and he was not even assigned a Nikke to his name.
He concluded that both his position as Deputy Chief, and his place as a soldier and citizen of the Ark were at risk if things continued.
He needed to prove himself, but he was incompetent.
That was when the Pilgrim, Dorothy, arrived in the Ark.
He found it suspicious. The timing was too conspicuous.
Doban became certain Dorothy had ulterior motives and began investigating her.
When Dorothy left the Ark on an exploration mission on the Utopia, he went so far as to plant a bug on her to find out her motives.
However, he learned nothing of significance, and there was no information about Dorothy anywhere in the Ark either.
A Nikke without records shouldn't exist. After exhaustive inquiries, Doban uncovered the existence of the Forbidden Library.
His position as Deputy Chief made that a possibility.
Doban set out to comb through the Forbidden Library.
However, the library's doors remained closed to him.
Breaking in without authorization would be a death sentence, even for a Deputy Chief.
Since there was no way access to the Forbidden Library would be granted to him, Doban was left stomping his feet in frustration.
After days of lurking around the Forbidden Library, he spotted a Nikke scoping out the same area.
Doban sensed that an opportunity would present itself in some form.
And sure enough, something miraculous happened.
There was a blackout in the Ark. Shortly after, the Nikke who had been loitering came sprinting out with a book in hand.
Doban shot the Nikke in the head, stole the book from her, and fled.
After reading everything written in that book, Doban let out a shout of triumph.
All records from the Forbidden Library carry inherent credibility, so the contents of the book could be trusted.
He became certain of Dorothy's intention.
He was convinced if he killed Dorothy before she brought ruin to the Ark, his standing would solidify for good.
Eliminating the instigator intent on destroying the Ark, right before any damage occurred.
Just imagining himself as the hero who averted the crisis and saved the Ark filled him with joy.
Doban. Guardian of the Ark.
While he yet stood, peace would reign in the Ark forever.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Answer me...

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: How do you know any of this?

lines.speaker: doban
lines.text: Everybody in the Ark knows it.

lines.speaker: doban
lines.text: Why would you think I wouldn't know?

lines.speaker: doban
lines.text: And, I know your motives too.

lines.speaker: doban
lines.text: Goddess Squad. The Goddess of Victory. Humanity's hope.

lines.speaker: doban
lines.text: To think that you, one of those legendary Nikkes, could have fallen this far... Pathetic.

lines.speaker: doban
lines.text: We will never hand the Ark over.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: ... I see. So you knew everything.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: So, what exactly do you plan to do about it?

lines.speaker: doban
lines.text: Isn't it obvious? I eliminate the outsider who is trying to throw the Ark into chaos.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Just one question.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Why did you abandon us?

lines.speaker: doban
lines.text: What are you talking about? You're the ones who abandoned the Ark.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: ... What did you say?

lines.speaker: doban
lines.text: The Goddess Squad demanded far too much.

lines.speaker: doban
lines.text: You wanted half of the Ark and the seat of supreme authority.

lines.speaker: doban
lines.text: Free control over military forces and unlimited access to resources.

lines.speaker: doban
lines.text: You didn't care what happened to the citizens. All you did was constantly demand things to serve your own interests.

lines.speaker: doban
lines.text: You even threatened us with force! Fortunately, the Ark was strong enough to withstand your assault!

lines.speaker: doban
lines.text: And when defeated, all of you fled the Ark with your tails tucked between your legs.

lines.speaker: doban
lines.text: Despite all that, to honor your contributions, the Ark elevated you to myth, enshrined you in monuments, and passed down your legend through the generations...!

lines.speaker: doban
lines.text: Instead of gratitude toward the Ark, this is how you repay us?!

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Have you ever seen us in person?

lines.speaker: doban
lines.text: No. I was born in the Ark.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Ahh. I see.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: So that's how they recorded it.
Doban knows the whole truth.
He knows the author of the Forbidden Library foresaw what fate awaited the Goddess Squad upon entering the Ark.
He knows they took on the role of villain, to prevent the Goddesses from being forgotten. And he knows why the Goddesses ended up the way they did.
But he doesn't say anything.
What matters now is for him, the Ark's Deputy Chief, to take down the outsider blinded by revenge and earn his merit.
So he must provoke Dorothy into giving him what he wants.

lines.speaker: doban
lines.text: All units! This Pilgrim has spread misinformation and incited unrest in the Ark! I want her captured alive!

lines.speaker: doban
lines.text: We must keep the Ark safe! We cannot allow an outsider to ruin everything we've built!

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: You really do have a way with words.
It's a battle of falsehood against falsehood.
If the official narrative regarding the Goddess Squad is as Doban says, then Burningum's passive treatment of her makes sense. But it doesn't matter.
The people whom Dorothy must appeal to are not those in power, but the Nikkes and the ordinary citizens.
Dorothy holds irrefutable proof that the Queen has descended.
Whatever Doban says about Dorothy's true intentions will crumble before the undeniable physical disaster looming ahead.
Both lies will come to light one day, but Dorothy is confident in her victory.
If the truth is great enough, even the small lies mixed into it have a way of becoming the truth.
To ensure that she'll come out on top when that decisive moment arrives, Dorothy decides she must first control public sentiment.
Dorothy once again cuts through the mass-produced Nikkes.
'Escaping would be easy, as would subduing them.'
'But I needs to come off as the victim, since the public tends to side with the weak.'
'I'll give them just enough of a fight and take some hits. But under no circumstances can I use my gun, and there must be absolutely no casualties.'
'I must appear as someone targeted by the Central Government for telling the truth.'
'Doban's actions here will give the Nikkes and citizens the confirmation they need.'
'Confirmation that the Central Government has been deceiving the Ark.'

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Why don't you take a nap?
Dorothy drives her knee into the abdomen of a mass-produced Nikke.
The Nikke bends at the waist and groans.
At that moment...
*Boom!*
The mass-produced Nikke explodes, sending fragments scattering everywhere.
The Nikke beside her charges with a shriek and lunges at Dorothy, trying to grab her.
Dorothy reflexively dodges and breaks the Nikke's stance.
*Boom!*
The Nikke staggers, then detonates.
